# TradeKey Importer Directory

> > Global B2B marketplace connecting suppliers with verified importers and buyers across industrial machinery, petroleum products, and diverse trade categories.

TradeKey Importer Directory provides comprehensive buyer and importer listings spanning major markets including India, China, UAE, Saudi Arabia, USA, Iran, and Turkey. The platform facilitates international trade connections across industrial equipment, petroleum products, and consumer goods with detailed contact information for procurement professionals.
